text:
Noah: Hey folks — my issued Mac is delayed in transit. Can I finish the security training and the phishing sim on my personal laptop while I wait?
Alyssa: Yes — the training and phish sim are tied to your user account, so completing them in a browser on a personal device is fine. :+1:
Sam: Important: do NOT enroll your personal device in Redwood MDM. Company devices only. If you get an MDM invite, ignore it and ping security.
Noah: Got it. What about doing code reviews and small PRs? I don't have SSH keys or the work laptop yet.
Jamie: For now use the GitHub web UI or Codespaces if you're approved. If you need terminal git pushes we can create a short-lived SSH cert scoped to your account.
Jamie: Example local approach if you must use terminal (keep keys separate):
```
# generate a throwaway key
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/redwood_temp -C "noah@redwood"
# add pub key to your fork or request a temp deploy key from eng
```
Sam: If we issue a temp SSH cert, it's audit-logged and expires automatically. Don't copy company secrets or KMS credentials to your personal machine.
Alyssa: We're arranging a loaner laptop + an ephemeral jumpbox VM you can RDP/ssh into for any sensitive work until your device arrives. Marta will handle pickup/dropoff.
Marta: Loaner reserved and placed at front desk. Front desk hours are 9:00-17:00. Noah — when can you stop by?
Noah: I can grab it tomorrow at 11:00am, thanks!
OnboardBot: Reminder: complete "Security Basics" and "Phishing Simulation" within 72 hours to keep onboarding on schedule. https://training.redwood.internal
Noah: One last question — will completing the phish sim from my personal laptop trigger any alerts or blocklists?
Sam: No, the simulation is tracked by your account and won't cause network intrusion alerts. Just don't submit secrets to unknown pages. If you think a real phish got through, use the "Report Phish" button or email security@redwood.
Alyssa: TL;DR: training & phish sim OK on personal browser; do NOT enroll personal device in MDM; loaner and jumpbox available; temp SSH workflows possible; contact security@redwood for urgent issues.
Noah: Perfect — thanks everyone :tada:
